headline: Indonesian Authorities Recover Black Box From Crashed Military Heli
seoTitle: Black Box Recovered From Crashed Indonesian Military Heli
metaDescription: Indonesian authorities have recovered the black box from a military helicopter that crashed during forest fire fighting operations in Central Kalimantan.
aiSummaryBullets: Search teams successfully recovered the flight data recorder from the Mi-17V5 military helicopter involved in the crash.
Five surviving crew members are being transported to medical facilities in Jakarta and Semarang for treatment.
Australia has deployed a C-130 Hercules aircraft to assist Indonesian efforts in extinguishing ongoing forest fires.
aiContextParagraph: A military helicopter operated by the Indonesian Army (TNI AD) recently crashed in Central Kalimantan while engaged in operations to suppress forest and land fires. The incident resulted in the loss of three military personnel, whose bodies have since been recovered by search teams. Authorities have now located and retrieved the black box from the wreckage, which is expected to aid in the investigation of the crash. Following the accident, the five surviving crew members were evacuated for medical care. In response to the escalating forest fire situation, the Australian government has initiated support by deploying a C-130 Hercules aircraft to assist with firefighting operations in the Kalimantan region from November 6 to November 12, 2026. Government officials and leadership, including high-ranking figures, have expressed formal condolences regarding the personnel fatalities occurred during these mission operations.
whyItIsViral: The incident has gained significant attention due to the loss of military personnel, the ongoing international assistance for the forest fires, and a high coverage velocity across multiple national news outlets.
